scope: targeted primary-source literature reading; not systematic review; author results not independently reproduced

papers.title: Hamiltonian Neural Networks
papers.constraint: hard continuous learned-energy conservation; generic RK4 is not exact energy preserving
papers.relevance: foundational generator baseline; not a PDE or observation-noise result

papers.title: Deep Energy-Based Modeling of Discrete-Time Physics
papers.constraint: discrete gradient implicit update preserves learned-energy behavior; explicit replacement does not inherit the same guarantee
papers.limitation: G assumed known in experiments; solver choice varies between comparisons

papers.title: Learning Chaotic Dynamics in Dissipative Systems
papers.arxiv_title: Learning Dissipative Dynamics in Chaotic Systems
papers.constraint: soft shell contraction training; optional hard dissipativity postprocessing far from attractor
papers.task: Lorenz63, KS, Kolmogorov flow; short trajectories and long statistics
papers.noise_evidence: large perturbations are not noisy-label robustness; noisy-supervision sweep not verified
papers.theory_scope: finite number of compositions on compact initial sets, existence of approximant

papers.title: Energy-consistent Neural Operators for Hamiltonian and Dissipative Partial Differential Equations
papers.constraint: soft energy-gradient-flow residual, jointly learned solution operator and energy density
papers.task: KdV, Cahn-Hilliard, Allen-Cahn, 2D Cahn-Hilliard; sparse-grid super-resolution
papers.compute: author reports up to 20x Vanilla NO training time; no matched-compute claim
papers.version_caveat: final paper selects G from candidates using validation; known-G-only caveat from 2024 preprint is outdated

papers.title: UEPI: Universal Energy-Behavior-Preserving Integrators for Energy Conservative/Dissipative Differential Equations
papers.constraint: hard discrete energy behavior with learned skew correction to a reference discrete gradient
papers.task: known energy and structure; optimize numerical integrator; nonlinear ODE and KdV
papers.compute: second-order, half-step and fourth-order reference methods; some total cost including data and training reported
papers.code_status: supplemental link verified; ZIP not unpacked

papers.title: GENERIC-FNO: Embedding Energy Conservation and Entropy Production into Fourier Neural Operators
papers.constraint: continuous learned-energy/entropy degeneracy identities; Jacobi identity not enforced; explicit time stepping drifts
papers.task: heat, advection, Burgers, damped wave; FNO and DeepONet
papers.compute: 128^2 forward approximately 4.4x, training step approximately 10x; larger FNO approximate compute comparison
limitations: 200-step results single run per cell; headline short horizon five seeds
bounded long-horizon predictions can be close to persistence
normalization affects physical dissipation and optimization; removing it helps 1D but fails 2D training

supplementary_lead.title: Identifiable learning of dissipative dynamics
supplementary_lead.caveat: nondegenerate stochastic dynamics with unique invariant density; process noise differs from noisy labels; not direct Burgers baseline
